cards.gloss_en: small toy figures shaped like people
cards.ex_en: The little girl lined up her dolls on the bed.
cards.ex_cn: 小女孩把她的娃娃排在床上。

cards.gloss_cn: 欢欣鼓舞地；得意洋洋地
cards.gloss_en: in a joyful and triumphant way
cards.ex_en: He raised his arms exultingly when his team scored.
cards.ex_cn: 他的队伍得分时，他欢欣鼓舞地举起了双臂。

cards.gloss_en: very well; splendidly
cards.ex_en: The old stove burned famously all through the cold night.
cards.ex_cn: 那台旧火炉在整个寒夜里烧得旺极了。

cards.gloss_en: a soft sweet fruit with many small seeds
cards.ex_en: She picked a ripe fig from the tree and ate it.
cards.ex_cn: 她从树上摘了一个熟透的无花果吃了。

cards.gloss_en: evergreen cone-bearing trees
cards.ex_en: Tall firs covered the slopes of the mountain.
cards.ex_cn: 高大的枞树覆盖着山坡。

cards.gloss_en: the quality of being fresh and new
cards.ex_en: I love the freshness of the air after the rain.
cards.ex_cn: 我喜欢雨后空气的清新。

cards.gloss_en: belonging to the gardener
cards.ex_en: The gardener's tools were kept in a small wooden shed.
cards.ex_cn: 园丁的工具放在一间小木棚里。

cards.gloss_en: a sweet cake or cookie flavored with ginger
cards.ex_en: We baked gingerbread shaped like little stars for the party.
cards.ex_cn: 我们为聚会烤了小星星形状的姜饼。

cards.gloss_en: a female servant who cleans a house
cards.ex_en: The housemaid swept the floors early every morning.
cards.ex_cn: 女仆每天清晨都打扫地板。

cards.gloss_en: in a way beyond comparison
cards.ex_en: The view from the peak was incomparably beautiful.
cards.ex_cn: 山顶的景色美得无与伦比。

cards.gloss_en: thin and having little fat
cards.ex_en: The lean cat squeezed through the narrow gap in the fence.
cards.ex_cn: 那只瘦猫从篱笆的窄缝里挤了过去。

cards.gloss_en: shade trees with heart-shaped leaves and fragrant flowers
cards.ex_en: The lindens along the street smelled sweet in summer.
cards.ex_cn: 夏天街道两旁的椴树散发着甜香。

cards.gloss_en: a special uniform worn by servants
cards.ex_en: The footmen wore green livery with shiny gold buttons.
cards.ex_cn: 仆役们穿着带亮金纽扣的绿色号衣。

cards.gloss_en: in a grand and dignified way
cards.ex_en: The eagle rose majestically above the tall cliffs.
cards.ex_cn: 雄鹰威严地飞升到高高的悬崖之上。

cards.gloss_en: small bags made of loosely woven material
cards.ex_en: They hung little nets of candy on the branches.
cards.ex_cn: 他们在树枝上挂了装糖果的小网兜。

cards.gloss_en: having a sweet and pleasant smell
cards.ex_en: Odorous blossoms filled the whole garden with perfume.
cards.ex_cn: 芳香的花朵让整个花园弥漫着香气。

cards.gloss_en: to decorate something to make it prettier
cards.ex_en: They ornament the hall with ribbons before every wedding.
cards.ex_cn: 每次婚礼前他们都用彩带装饰大厅。

cards.gloss_en: decorated to look more beautiful
cards.ex_en: The cake was ornamented with tiny sugar flowers.
cards.ex_cn: 蛋糕上点缀着小小的糖花。

cards.gloss_en: pretty objects used to decorate something
cards.ex_en: We hung shiny ornaments all over the Christmas tree.
cards.ex_cn: 我们在圣诞树上挂满了闪亮的装饰品。

cards.gloss_en: fine white china used for cups and dishes
cards.ex_en: Grandmother kept her best porcelain in a glass cabinet.
cards.ex_cn: 祖母把她最好的瓷器收在玻璃柜里。

cards.gloss_en: painted pictures of people
cards.ex_en: Old family portraits hung along the staircase wall.
cards.ex_cn: 楼梯墙上挂着古老的家族肖像画。
